1217 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
Start: 1217-06-20.  
Add 322 days:  
June: 10 days left (June 30 - June 20 = 10 days).  
July: 31 → total 41 days.  
August: 31 → 72 days.  
September: 30 → 102 days.  
October: 31 → 133 days.  
November: 30 → 163 days.  
December: 31 → 194 days.  
January 1218: 31 → 225 days.  
February 1218: 28 → 253 days.  
March: 31 → 284 days.  
April: 30 → 314 days.  
322 - 314 = 8 days into May.  
So new date: 1218-05-08.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1218-05-08
